excerpt: Scale AI supplies AI training data, model evaluation and AI agents for companies and governments. What it does, the Meta deal, its new CEO and alternatives.
content:
Scale AI is a San Francisco company, founded in 2016, that helps organisations build and deploy AI. It started as a supplier of high-quality training data for machine-learning teams, and that is still a large part of the business: its About page says AI models have been trained on 15 billion human decisions gathered through Scale and that it has paid $1 billion to contributors around the world. It now also sells model evaluation and red-teaming, and AI applications and agents for businesses and the public sector. The company says it has more than 1,000 employees, and customers named on its About page include Meta, Cohere, Adept, Cisco and TIME.

Products

Scale groups its work into three parts. The Scale Data Engine produces and labels the data used to train and fine-tune models. The GenAI portfolio covers building and evaluating generative AI for enterprises, including what it describes as rigorous model evaluations and red-teaming to measure, benchmark and improve AI performance. Scale Donovan is its line of AI agents for the public sector, aimed at public-sector organisations.

Meta's investment and the leadership change

On 12 June 2025 Scale announced a significant new investment from Meta Platforms, which broadened the two companies' commercial partnership and left Meta with a minority stake. Scale said the deal valued it at over $29 billion. At the same time its founder and CEO, Alexandr Wang, left to work on Meta's AI efforts, while remaining a director on Scale's board, and the board named chief strategy officer Jason Droege interim CEO.

On 30 July 2026 Reuters reported that Scale had named Francis deSouza as chief executive, effective 10 August. DeSouza was previously chief operating officer and president of security products at Google Cloud, and before that president and CEO of the genomics company Illumina. Droege was to work with him during the transition. Scale's About page now lists deSouza as CEO.

Pricing

Scale does not publish prices. Its pricing page is a booking form for a one-to-one introductory call, so the cost of data, evaluation or Donovan work is set per project with its sales team.

We have not tested Scale AI ourselves. This page brings together Scale AI's official site, its own announcements and reputable news coverage, plus the public pages of the products it is compared with, and says where each fact comes from.
